analysis.reasonEn: Daily RSI at 35.3 failed to rebound after entering oversold territory, and MACD histogram worsened from positive 5 days ago to negative currently. ADX at 30.6 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is above +DI, signaling a bearish phase. Volume ratio of 0.48 for 5 consecutive days suggests a lack of buying pressure. Current price at 58,585 is 9.7% above the 52-week low of 37,815, indicating potential for further decline. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach, considering a possible drop to the 41,000 swing support.
